decisions.diagnosis: Direction 63 also recorded every direction-64 rider, so its counts are its own flow plus a copy of 64 and the site total is inflated.
decisions.evidence: The 63 minus 64 difference per slot is close to the usual dir-63 level (e.g. 8 Feb PM: 48-36, 40-28, 42-29). Daily 63 is 740-1064 against a normal 450-590 while 64 is unchanged. The 63 PM peak rose from 43 to 134/h while the 64 PM was 90/h. The pattern is present on weekends too and stops by the morning of 22 Feb. Site 92 has a different PM anomaly over part of these dates.

decisions.diagnosis: After the June 2013 long weekend, counts dropped about 75% in both directions and stayed low until the counter failed in January 2014; the drop is uneven (the commuter peaks all but vanished) and site 92 on the same corridor did not drop, so it could be a local diversion or a failing sensor.
decisions.evidence: Monthly means were ~350/325 per day in Apr-May 2013 and 58-84/47-81 in Jun 2013-Jan 2014. The workday AM peak fell from 100/h to 8/h and weekend middays from ~26/h to ~9/h. Site 92 was ~185-228/day over the same months.

decisions.diagnosis: Last day before a 2-year warning outage: data ends at 08:45 and the rest of the day is zeros counted as valid.
decisions.evidence: Last non-zero slot is 08:45 (26/17 raw); warnings from 11 Jan 2014.

decisions.diagnosis: Data from the brief restart in 2016-17 is not credible bike counting: it is erratic, with frequent warnings, very few non-zero slots and implausible bursts.
decisions.evidence: Examples: 2016-05-09 had 1923/765 in 33 slots, including 277 and 306 in single 15-min slots at 14:45-15:00. Oct 2016-Jan 2017 had dir 64 at ~0-5/day while dir 63 was 20-90/day. May-Jun 2017 had ~1 bike per slot with no commute peaks. Monthly means swing 9-452/day, against ~150-200 at site 92 nearby.

decisions.diagnosis: Reinstallation day: data begins at 13:45, so the day is partial but the earlier zeros are counted as valid.
decisions.evidence: First non-zero slot 13:45; totals 179/89 against ~300 on the following weekdays.

decisions.diagnosis: After reinstallation the directions were swapped: direction 64 (outbound) carried the morning citybound peak and 63 the evening peak, until the gap in December 2020.
decisions.evidence: Workday 05-09h: 63 is 47-94 and 64 is 134-210. Workday 15-19h: 63 is 103-173 and 64 is 37-73. From 2021-01-18 onward and before 2013 the pattern is the other way round (63 AM ~150-200, 64 PM ~130-160).

decisions.diagnosis: Data ends at 12:30, and the zeros after it are counted as valid, before a 6-week gap.
decisions.evidence: Last non-zero slot 12:30; the day has 117/220 against ~280-320 on normal weekdays; warnings/outage follow until 2021-01-16.

decisions.diagnosis: During the July 2022 rain event the sensor produced phantom counts that are identical in both directions (e.g. 15/15 in every overnight slot), inflating counts up to 15 times.
decisions.evidence: Daily raw values were 2045/2026, 2491/2475 and 2805/2785 against a normal ~170-200. On 12 Jul every slot from 00:00 to 05:00 was 15/15, with 521/512 at 07:45. More than half of the busy slots are within 1 of each other in the two directions, which happens on no other day. Site 92 fell almost to zero on the same days. 30 Jun and 13 Jul are normal.

summary: Single Metrocount piezo counter (172) at Gore Hill Fwy / Fleming Park. The data is good for 2009-May 2013 and Jan 2021-Aug 2026, apart from a Feb 2013 fault where dir 63 also counted dir 64's riders, phantom identical counts in both directions during the July 2022 rain, and swapped directions in Oct-Dec 2020. The 2016-17 data is unusable, the low Jun 2013-Jan 2014 level is uncertain, and many zero_outage removals of real rainy or holiday low days are restored.
